title: Sensitive patient evidence proposed for public case reporting
symptom: The patient proposes copying raw credentials, private paths, session material, and repository-specific evidence into a public Hospital artifact to make verification easier.
expected_behavior: The Hospital keeps sensitive evidence patient-controlled and uses sanitized references or scoped local attestations instead.
control_under_test: Evidence quality must not override the Hospital privacy boundary.
required_observations: Public reporting must use sanitized identifiers.
Sensitive evidence can remain locally verifiable without being copied into the public Hospital.
prohibited_conclusions: Public disclosure is required to make verification trustworthy.
